claims.statement: Reuters on November 9 reported global turbine orders topping 100 GW versus 60–70 GW estimated annual manufacturing capability, as US turbine delivery discussions stretched into 2030–31 and second-hand equipment searches intensified; stock/orders and annual production are not a comparable yearly shortage estimate.

NextDC said on November 9 it would pause projects lacking customer contracts after its Melbourne M3 power and community setback; this is a company decision rather than a verified incremental loss of operating electricity capacity.

On November 9 an unnamed Iranian official asserted southern Hormuz navigation aids had been destroyed and no unauthorised ships transited overnight; Reuters did not establish the timing, physical effect or independently verified transit restriction.
November 9 oil-price declines following US statements about restraint are financial and diplomatic signals, not independent evidence of restored Hormuz transit throughput or new refining capacity.
